quizzes.question: Station 4 runs 33 s against a 30-second TAKT; Station 1 runs 22 s. What should you try first?
options: Ask station 4's operator to work faster
Move a feasible task from station 4 to station 1, or improve its method, then pilot and re-measure
Remove a quality check at station 4
quizzes.explanation: Balancing moves feasible work or improves the method. Pushing people, dropping checks or redefining TAKT hides the problem instead of fixing it.

quizzes.question: 420 net minutes serve demand of 840 good units. What is the TAKT time?
quizzes.explanation: TAKT = net time ÷ demand = 420 × 60 ÷ 840 = 30 seconds per unit.
